· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.0026→-0.0021): 데드크로스 발생 후 악화, 약세 신호

[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): 52주 저점 부근에서 횡보, 명확한 추세 전환 신호 부재로 관망 유지 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.20) below SMA5/20 ($0.21/$0.21), aligned with SMA50 ($0.20): short-term bearish, mid-term neutral
· Above SMA100 ($0.18), below SMA200 ($0.22): mixed long-term trend
· 52-week position (8.1%) + current price near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (53.3→48.5): continuing sideways in neutral range, turning bearish
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0026→-0.0021): dead cross occurred and worsening, bearish signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $0.21): band width narrowed to 16.73%, lacking directionality
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.19): based on 5-day/20-day lows, aligned with lower BB
· Swing resistance ($0.21): aligned with SMA5/20 and BB midline, potential for short-term bounce on breakout
· 5-day high ($0.22) < 20-day high ($0.23): Lower High pattern forming, bearish continuation
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.04x): normal level, moderate confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): consolidating near 52-week lows, maintaining wait-and-see due to lack of clear trend reversal signals
